description: Get the authenticated member's own LinkedIn profile.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the profile object (id, name, headline, location, industry, summary, numConnections, etc.); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List the authenticated member's first-degree connections, paginated.

start.description: Zero-based offset of the first connection to return (default 0).

count.description: Maximum number of connections to return in the page (default 50).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has 'elements' (a list of connection objects) and 'paging' (start, count, total); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List posts, optionally filtered by author, sorted newest first and paginated.

author_id.description: Optional author id (person or organization urn) to filter posts by.

start.description: Zero-based offset of the first post to return (default 0).

count.description: Maximum number of posts to return in the page (default 50).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has 'elements' (a list of post objects) and 'paging' (start, count, total); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single post by its id.

post_id.description: The unique id of the post.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the post object; on failure (post not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new post authored by a member or organization.

commentary.description: The text body of the post.

author_id.description: Optional author id (person or organization urn); defaults to the authenticated member's id.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created post object (id, author_id, commentary, visibility, created_at, socialDetail); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single organization by its id.

org_id.description: The unique id of the organization.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the organization object (id, name, industry, website, location, followerCount, etc.); on failure (organization not found), output contains an error message.

description: Search job postings by keywords and/or location, sorted newest first and paginated.

keywords.description: Optional search term matched against job title, description, and keyword tags.

location.description: Optional location substring to filter jobs by.

start.description: Zero-based offset of the first job to return (default 0).

count.description: Maximum number of jobs to return in the page (default 50).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has 'elements' (a list of job objects) and 'paging' (start, count, total); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single job posting by its id.

job_id.description: The unique id of the job posting.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the job object (id, title, organizationId, location, employmentType, keywords, applicants, description, etc.); on failure (job not found), output contains an error message.
